first_reading.quote: The hour hand appears to point near the 11, slightly past it toward 12? Let's look. There's a hand pointing up-left toward the 11 region (between 11 and 12, closer to 11-12 boundary but the tip is near the 11-12 area). Actually the shorter hand (hour hand) points to around the 11-12 area, just before 12. The longer hand (minute hand) points down near the 6 (just past 6, around the 29-30 minute mark).

note: 首次描述时针在11与12间、分针在29–30分附近；最终主要给出约11:29。
